Explorer's Camp

How to Play Quizy

Welcome, Explorer! Quizy turns questions into an adventure. Choose a land, answer the questions, learn from the feedback, and keep exploring.

🗺️ 1. Choose your adventure

Pick an adventure land and enter an expedition. Quizy gives you questions suited to your age group and chosen difficulty.

🧠 2. Think before you answer

Read the question carefully and choose the answer you believe is correct. Take your time—learning is more important than rushing.

❤️ 3. Watch your lives

Wrong answers can cost a life, so use what you know and think carefully. Keep learning and try again when you need to.

💡 4. Use your Explorer's tools

  • Explorer's Lens can give you a helpful hint.
  • Read Challenge can read questions aloud.
  • Discover More gives you an extra learning adventure after an answer.

⭐ 5. Collect rewards

Complete challenges to earn coins, achievements and progress through your Quizy journey.

📚 6. Learn from every answer

Even when you get an answer wrong, you have discovered something new. Read the feedback, use Discover More, and carry the lesson into your next question.

🏆 7. Keep exploring

Quizy is a journey, not a race. Explore different lands, challenge yourself, and keep growing your knowledge.

Family Village

Safety & Parents

Quizy is designed as a child-friendly learning adventure. Families can help make the experience safe, balanced, and useful.

👨‍👩‍👧 Explore together

Parents and guardians can encourage children to talk about what they learned and explore questions together.

🔒 Protect private information

Children should not share passwords, private contact details, or other sensitive personal information through Quizy feedback or reports.

⏰ Keep learning balanced

Quizy is one learning activity among many. Encourage children to take breaks, read, play, rest, and enjoy offline activities too.

🛠️ Need help?

Use the Fix-It Workshop to report a technical problem, or contact the Quizy team when you have a question or concern.

Scroll Temple

Terms & Privacy

📜 Use of Quizy

Quizy is an educational game intended to support learning through interactive questions and exploration. Please use the service responsibly and respectfully.

🔒 Privacy

Do not enter passwords, financial information, or other sensitive personal information into Quizy feedback or support messages. Only provide information needed to help with your request.

🧭 Educational content

Quizy provides educational material and explanations for learning purposes. Children and families should use appropriate judgment and seek trusted adult guidance where needed.

🛠️ Problems & feedback

Reports and suggestions help improve Quizy. Please describe problems accurately and do not submit someone else's private information.

For questions about Quizy, use the contact information provided in Quizy HQ.

🛠️
Fix-It Workshop

Report a Problem

Found something that doesn't work properly? Tell the Quizy team what happened so we can investigate it.

🔧 What should you report?

  • A button or screen that does not respond.
  • A question, answer, image, or explanation that looks incorrect.
  • A game problem such as progress, lives, coins, or another feature behaving unexpectedly.
  • Anything that makes Quizy confusing or difficult to use.

📝 What to include

Describe what you were trying to do, what happened, and what you expected to happen instead. If you know the land or question involved, include that too.

📧 Quizy Support

Send your report to uchep1990@gmail.com

Please don't include passwords or other private information in a problem report.

Knowledge Library

Learning Guide

Welcome to the Knowledge Library, Explorer! Quizy is designed to make learning feel like an adventure. Every question is a chance to discover something new.

🧭 Learn by exploring

Choose an adventure land and work through its questions. Different lands give you opportunities to explore different areas of knowledge.

🎯 Choose the right challenge

Quizy lets you play with age groups and difficulty settings. Choose the setting that matches the learner and the challenge you want.

🧠 A wrong answer can still teach you

When an answer is wrong, don't just move on. Read the feedback carefully. The explanation is part of the lesson.

🔎 Use your Explorer's tools

  • Explorer's Lens helps with hints when you need a little guidance.
  • Read Challenge can read questions aloud.
  • Discover More takes a question further with an extra learning extension.

🌟 Make curiosity your superpower

If a question makes you curious, explore the explanation and Discover More section. The goal is not only to collect correct answers, but to understand what you are learning.

🏆 Progress comes with practice

Keep exploring, learn from mistakes, and return to topics you want to understand better. Your Quizy journey grows one question at a time.
